Based on my research, here are the companies that were in the top 10 most valuable publicly traded companies on both December 31, 2013 and December 31, 2022, along with their CEOs in 2022:

## Companies That Remained in the Top 10 (2013 → 2022)

| Company | 2013 Rank | 2022 Rank | CEO in 2022 |
|---------|-----------|-----------|-------------|
| **Apple** | #1 | #1 | Tim Cook |
| **Microsoft** | #3 | #2 | Satya Nadella |
| **Alphabet (Google)** | #4 | #3 | Sundar Pichai |
| **Berkshire Hathaway** | #5 | #5 | Warren Buffett |
| **Johnson & Johnson** | #7 | #7 | Joaquin Duato |
| **ExxonMobil** | #2 | #8 | Darren W. Woods |

## Summary

**6 out of 10 companies** from the 2013 list remained in the top 10 by 2022. The companies that dropped out were:
- General Electric (#6 in 2013)
- Walmart (#8 in 2013)
- Hoffmann-La Roche (#9 in 2013)
- Chevron Corporation (#10 in 2013)

The companies that entered the top 10 by 2022 were:
- Amazon (#4)
- UnitedHealth (#6)
- Visa (#9)
- Tencent (#10)

Remarkably, **Apple maintained the #1 position** for both years, while **Warren Buffett (Berkshire Hathaway)** and **Tim Cook (Apple)** were the longest-tenured CEOs among this group, with Buffett leading since 1965 and Cook since 2011.

content:
Based on the Wikipedia article "List of public corporations by market capitalization," I found the Fourth Quarter 2022 rankings (as of December 31, 2022). Here are the **top 10 companies by market capitalization at the end of 2022**:

| Rank | Company | Country | Market Cap (USD millions) |
|------|---------|---------|---------------------------|
| 1 | **Apple** | United States | $2,066,000 |
| 2 | **Microsoft** | United States | $1,787,000 |
| 3 | **Alphabet** | United States | $1,145,000 |
| 4 | **Amazon** | United States | $856,940 |
| 5 | **Berkshire Hathaway** | United States | $681,770 |
| 6 | **UnitedHealth** | United States | $495,370 |
| 7 | **Johnson & Johnson** | United States | $461,840 |
| 8 | **ExxonMobil** | United States | $454,240 |
| 9 | **Visa** | United States | $439,950 |
| 10 | **Tencent** | China | $405,090 |

**Key Observations:**
- All figures are in USD millions
- 9 of the top 10 companies were US-based, with only Tencent (China) outside the US at position 10
- Apple led by a significant margin with over $2 trillion market cap
- There was notable movement from Q3 to Q4 2022, with Tesla dropping out of the top 10 (it was ranked 5th in Q3 but 13th by Q4)
- Berkshire Hathaway moved up from 6th in Q3 to 5th in Q4
- This data reflects the market conditions at the end of a challenging year for many stocks in 2022

Based on my Wikipedia search, **Tim Cook** was the CEO of Apple Inc. in 2022. 

According to the Wikipedia article, Timothy Donald Cook (born November 1, 1960) is an American business executive who has been the chief executive officer of Apple Inc. since 2011. He succeeded co-founder Steve Jobs and has continued to serve in this role through 2022 and beyond (the article lists his tenure as "2011–present").

Before becoming CEO, Cook previously served as Apple's chief operating officer under Steve Jobs and joined Apple in March 1998 as senior vice president for worldwide operations, later serving as executive vice president for worldwide sales and operations.
